title: Kipseli Base reserve (unverified ERC1967 proxy) — all value paths operator/Safe-gated
closed_reasons: withdraw(address,uint256,address) and convertETH(uint256) revert 'caller is not operator' for any external EOA
emergencyWithdraw/setAllowance/addOperators/removeOperators/transferOwnership/renounceOwnership revert 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'
proxy upgradeAndCall is gated to the custom ProxyAdmin whose owner() is the operator EOA
no approved withdrawal destination exists (even the real operator reverts 'destination is not approved')
all 20 state-changing dispatcher selectors revert for an unprivileged caller (fork-proven)
key_facts: Reserve 0xBEE3211ab312a8D065c4FeF0247448e17A8da000 is an ERC1967 proxy (impl 0x45A507EB92dDF5ab6F10e0a0d124B247e75992a8, admin 0x8Bb03250fD720A6f2Dc043616532c92bd2D42f6E); both unverified

single operator = EOA 0x97F7d4093e5Bdd0776e2Ca90C90124c5e16Ca569 (also a Safe signer and the proxy-admin owner)

caveats: Both the proxy and the implementation are unverified; the gate mapping was recovered by heimdall decompilation + dynamic eth_call, not from source.

The value is P-class: a compromised operator EOA key (or 2 Safe signers) could drain; that is privileged, not external-unprivileged.
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract $0 from the Kipseli Base reserve (~$527.5k live): every value-moving selector is gated to the operator EOA 0x97F7d409... or the 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe owner, and the withdrawal destination allowlist is empty.
